name: packt-agentic-frontends-workshop
description: Presenter starter for completed milestones 1–7; Angular, CopilotKit, and Mastra.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @packt-workshop/contracts build && pnpm --filter @packt-workshop/facility-service build && pnpm --parallel --filter @packt-workshop/facility-service --filter angular-host dev
scripts.dev:backend: pnpm --filter @packt-workshop/contracts build && pnpm --filter @packt-workshop/facility-service build && pnpm --parallel --filter @packt-workshop/facility-service dev
scripts.dev:all: pnpm --filter @packt-workshop/contracts build && pnpm --filter @packt-workshop/facility-service build && pnpm --parallel --filter @packt-workshop/facility-service --filter @packt-workshop/agent-service --filter angular-host dev
scripts.check:types: pnpm --filter @packt-workshop/contracts build && pnpm --filter @packt-workshop/facility-service build && pnpm --filter @packt-workshop/agent-service exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter angular-host build
